name: basilbook/khqr
description: KHQR, Cambodia's payment QR: make one, read one back, its Bakong md5, draw it as PNG or SVG, and ask Bakong whether it was paid. The PHP twin of @basilbook/khqr.

suggest.ext-gd: To draw a KHQR as a PNG (Khqr::image with type png). SVG needs nothing.
suggest.ext-intl: Folds accented names with Unicode NFKD. Without it, a built-in table folds the same Latin letters.
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Used as the HTTP client of BakongClient when you do not pass a PSR-18 client of your own.
